info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Recruitment Update API
info.description: The Recruitment Update API allows organizations to modify existing recruitment records efficiently. This API is designed for updating details such as candidate information, job postings, and interview schedules associated with a specific recruitment process. It is primarily utilized by HR professionals and recruitment teams to streamline their hiring processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can ensure that their recruitment data is current and accurate, improving overall hiring efficiency.

patch.description: This operation allows for the modification of an existing recruitment resource, enabling updates to attributes and status as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of the recruitment process identified by RES-100045. You can modify various attributes related to the recruitment record based on the provided schema.
